name: Spooky Solving Frisco 2026
information: This competition is being held at the Sci-Tech Discovery Center, a children's science museum inside the Frisco Discovery Center. Admission to the museum for the competitor and any parent/chaperone is included with your registration fee. This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjUxMzcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9863833688a5f44433b5f4dc6d8a75f973072f10/southernCubing%203-01.png)
